biggest_catch: Userlytics publishes no official session duration — without it, the per-study incentive ($10–$50) can't be turned into a verified time-for-money route.
catches: No official session duration published anywhere in official tester materials.
The $10–$50 incentive is shown as a per-study example; actual pay varies per test.
Your test must be reviewed and approved by the client before any payment.
Official FAQ says payments every 15 days, but the tester ToS allows up to 30 days after test completion.
Per-test screeners gate every test; invites are random and limited.

c1.evidence: Official Userlytics tester pages and tester Terms of Service describe the program and payment terms.

c2.evidence: Official tester page displays 'Incentive per study $10–$50.'

c3.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Payments for approved tests are made once every 15 days.' Tester ToS: 'You are paid a maximum of 30 days after fully completing a test.'

c4.evidence: Free signup; no fee in official materials.

eligibility: Tester signup; per-test screeners; client review and approval required for payment
maximize: Not verifiable as a route — no official duration published. Only accept tests whose invite states a pay amount and expected length you would accept; answer screeners honestly since poor ratings cut future invites.
notes: Official FAQ (userlytics.com/make-money-online, fetched 2026-09-23): payments every 15 days for approved tests; tester ToS allows up to 30 days. The official page displays an 'Incentive per study $10–$50' example, but no official session duration is published, so the route fails the evidence bar. Third-party duration claims (20–40 min) were excluded.
